notes: Curated real NASA DONKI (Space Weather Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information) solar flare (FLR), CME, SEP, and geomagnetic storm (GST) records via api.nasa.gov/DONKI. Always tagged ARCHIVED when served from bundle; LIVE only when fetched live from api.nasa.gov.

events.summary: Calm solar conditions recorded by NASA SDO/GOES. Background cosmic rays remain low.
events.realPlannerNote: Mission planners schedule outdoor rover trips and antenna repairs during quiet solar windows.

events.summary: Moderate M4.8 solar flare observed on the solar limb. Minor particle bump expected.
events.realPlannerNote: Planners check battery reserves and verify storm shelter hatches are clear just in case activity grows.

events.summary: Real May 2024 X8.7 solar flare from monster sunspot AR 3664! High-energy protons surging toward Moon & Mars.
events.realPlannerNote: NASA's Moon to Mars Space Weather Analysis Office issues an SEP watch, telling crews to halt EVAs and prepare shielding.

events.summary: Real October 2024 X9.0 solar flare from Sunspot AR 3842 — one of the strongest flares of Solar Cycle 25!
events.realPlannerNote: Planners prioritize battery charging before shielding drains the grid, and delay unshielded surface sorties.

events.summary: Severe G5 / S3 Solar Energetic Particle storm from AR 3664 hitting the outpost! Proton flux surging!
events.realPlannerNote: Astronauts shelter immediately inside water-lined or regolith-covered storm zones until proton flux drops below 10 pfu.
